integrity: All scientific claims are backed by the displayed analytic proof; a symbolic algebra checker corroborates the energy identity, coefficient and sharpness example. Same-model review is not independent certification. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic \(t^{-1}\) coefficient requires \(\beta=d\), \(r>b+\alpha/m\), positive present-state populations and nonnegative continuous histories, constant finite gestation delays, and strictly positive fixed model rates. Predator extinction for \(\beta\le d\) needs no extra prey-growth condition. No classification is proved for arbitrary \(\beta>d\) or time-varying/stochastic/spatial models.
title: Critical \(t^{-1}\) predator extinction with an exact gestation-delay factor
